text: DSH Hover Information 是面向 web 客户端的会话悬浮卡片增强插件。它在会话卡片上加入复制会话 ID 和工作区路径的按钮，并从会话日志生成统计信息，通过可配置的指标区显示轮次、步骤、输入输出 token、压缩次数、上下文、子代理、模型和工具调用等。还可在模型选择器中展示 provider 与 model。适合需要快速识别、复制会话信息并查看用量概况的 DSH 用户；无需额外账号或密钥。

DSH Hover Information enhances web session cards with buttons to copy session IDs and workspace paths. Its configurable metrics show turns, tokens, context, compactions, subagents, model, and tool calls. It can show provider with model. No extra account or API key is needed.
想在会话悬浮卡片上快速复制会话 ID。
希望从会话列表卡片直接复制工作区路径。
有没有办法在悬浮卡片里查看 token 用量和轮数？
让 DSH 会话卡片显示上下文占用和压缩次数。
想按需开关会话卡片上的统计指标。
Show token usage and context details on session hover cards.
Copy a session ID or workspace path from its card.
Display the provider alongside the selected model.
DSH Hover Information 的功能「复制会话信息」：在悬浮卡片标题区域提供按钮，将会话 ID 或工作区路径复制到剪贴板；剪贴板 API 不可用时尝试文本框回退。
DSH Hover Information 的功能「查看会话指标」：悬浮卡片可展示轮次、步骤、token、缓存、压缩、清理、上下文、子代理、模型、工具调用、活跃时间和创建时间等指标。
DSH Hover Information 的功能「配置卡片指标」：通过插件行配置表单开关单项指标，并设置 1000 至 60000 毫秒的刷新间隔。
DSH Hover Information 的功能「显示模型提供方」：可在 composer 模型选择器中将 provider 与 model 一起展示。

**Preview card**

Configurable metrics block, configured on this bundle's own configuration page
on the Plugins page (turning the bundle row off is what disables the whole
enhancement):

@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information README · @comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information：- **Copy session ID** / **Copy workspace path** icons on the card's header
  row — `⧉ copy ID` / `⧉ copy path` beside the status dot and the relative
  time, instead of the stock whole-card copy button.
- **Metrics block**: turns, steps, tokens sent/received, cache tokens,
  compactions, purges (tool-result prunes), context window, subagents, model,
  tool calls, active time and created date — toggled per metric.

**Model selector**

@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information README · @comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information：- **Provider in the selector**: tooltip and visible value read
  `Provider > Model`.

@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information README · Install：Then restart the `web` host — browser bundles don't hot-update, and
the live `dsh web` gateway is never restarted by tooling.

@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information README · Develop：The row card is built on the shared base layer
[`@comecaramelos/dsh-ancesters`](https://github.com/ComeCaramelos/dsh-ancesters),
linked as a sibling checkout (`file:../dsh-ancesters`) — build it first.

```sh
npm install
npm run build      # tsc (host) + tsc typecheck + esbuild (browser) → lib/
npm test           # builds first, then node --test
```

@comecaramelos/dsh-hover-information README · Develop：Sources live in `src/host/**` (host half) and `src/client/**` (browser half);
`src/index.ts` is the host's re-export-only face, and `scripts/build-client.mjs`
collapses the browser half into one `lib/client.js` lazy-CJS bundle. `lib/` is
build output and is git-ignored. Every consumer —
the profile row, the browser bundle and the tests — resolves it through
`package.json#exports`, so run the build after editing sources and before
pointing a profile checkout at this tree. See [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) 
for the layout and the verification recipe.
